contentList.content: Way of the Drunken Master
Way of the Drunken Master
A drunken master sways, tottering on unsteady feet to present what seems like an incompetent combatant who proves frustrating to engage.
The Way of the Drunken Master teaches its students to move with the jerky, unpredictable movements of a drunkard.
Drunken Technique

You learn how to twist and turn quickly as part of your Flurry of Blows. Whenever you use Flurry of Blows, you gain the benefit of the Disengage action, and your walking speed increases by 10 feet until the end of the current turn.
Drunken Performance
Your martial arts technique mixes combat training with the precision of a dancer and the antics of a jester. You gain Performance proficiency, and will pretend to be drunk.
"Drunk"
You are pretending to be drunk. Gain proficiency in Performance.
Tipsy Sway: Redirect
Creature's attack is currently being redirected by the Monk.
Tipsy Sway: Redirect Attack
When a creature misses you with a melee attack roll, you can spend 1 ki point and a reaction to cause that attack to hit one random creature that you can see within 5 feet.
Tipsy Sway: Leap to Your Feet
When you're prone, you can stand up by spending 5 feet of movement, rather than half your speed.
Reaction: Tipsy Sway Redirect Attack
Reaction: Drunkards Luck
You always seem to get a lucky bounce at the right moment. When you make an attack roll or saving throw and have disadvantage, you can spend 2 ki points to gain advantage instead.
Drunkards Luck

You always seem to get a lucky bounce at the right moment. When you make an ability check, you can spend 2 ki points to gain advantage. Can enable passive to gain advantage on passive rolls. Passive will disable after each roll.
Intoxicated Frenzy
You gain the ability to make an overwhelming number of attacks against a group of enemies. When you use your Flurry of Blows, you can make up to three additional unarmed attacks.
Make up to three unarmed attacks on enemies in melee range.
